title: PDF to Text: Extract Text and Metadata from PDF URLs

urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Direct links to PDF files, up to 2,000 per run (60 MB each at most).

includePageTexts.title: Also return text per page
includePageTexts.description: Adds pageTexts: one text per page, in addition to the whole-document text.

maxPagesPerPdf.title: Maximum pages per PDF
maxPagesPerPdf.description: Read at most this many pages of each PDF (you pay only for pages read).

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip files the site asks bots not to fetch. Recommended.
